== Published English Original Virtual Set 8 wording ==
The remaster drops the piloted requirement, asks for a Death Star II starship, and gives a once-per-game additional move instead of sacrificing the Effect for an additional regular move. The older slip prints one dot and the later slip leaves the dot off. The underlying unique card and period Virtual card rule support the same degree of uniqueness for both.
